verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs say users can send manual and automatic invoices from their account and accept flexible payment methods. Its Accounts Receivable API lets you create invoices, download invoice PDFs, collect by card or ACH debit and track when each invoice is paid, with plan-based invoice limits. missing for 10: no evidence of branding or customization of invoices (logo, colors, templates), no independent or hands-on corroboration of the invoicing and payment-collection flow.
